text: Breaker row. The shutter's third from the left. Leave the rest alone, they feed the hall.
style: A grid engineer in her early thirties who helped build an outage believing nobody would be hurt, and turned. Consistent Californian American accent with Mexican-American Spanish inflection throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Mid-range pitch. Tonight she is on the line from custody: the technical sentences come out steady and fast, the ones about herself do not.
